metrics.bytes: program bytes where the program is kept; LoRA bytes (only) where the LoRA is used; 0 where the prior is kept
metrics.evaluation: final states 30-49 (m3_final rows of the chosen arm), paired against practice_lora (LoRA wherever the prior fails) and ours_dim1_last2 (the program wherever the prior fails)

hypotheses.A1: ours_alloc is non-inferior to practice_lora at -0.10 (one-sided 95% cluster bootstrap)
hypotheses.A2: ours_alloc stores less than half of practice_lora's bytes

metrics.rule: ALLOCATE BYTES BY PRACTICE: (1) keep the prior if its zero-shot practice (states 0-9, m3_compose) succeeds >= 0.5; (2) else practise the composed program -- borrowing at every frame + the 258 KB fold where the demo grasps (dimfold_s1_last2; dimcode_s1 where it does not) -- on the same states 0-9 (experiment m3_practice, tag dimbest) and keep it if it succeeds >= 0.5; (3) else train the rank-16 LoRA (18.7 MB) and use it.
metrics.tasks: all tasks of m3_final where the prior's practice fails
metrics.written_before: any wave A/B final row except tasks 1 and 6 (zero-shot, replay, borrowing at every 5th frame, borrowing + fold, LoRA)

notes: conceived after the 6-task final results, registered before the wave A/B results
